title: Normalized financial statements (v2)
description: Ordered statement lines per statement. Values are as presented: revenue/assets positive, expenses and cash outflows NEGATIVE, so every subtotal is a plain sum of its total_of components. Legacy v1 input (flat per-period 'values') is still accepted and converted automatically.

demo.description: true only for synthetic test data. Never set it on a user's document.

unit.description: Unit of the figures exactly as printed (元 = ones, 千元 = thousands, 万元 = ten_thousands, 百万元 = millions; ₹ in lakhs = lakhs, ₹ in crores = crores).

display_unit.description: Optional. Workbook display unit; values stay exact. Default: millions when source figures are in ones/thousands and exceed 1bn.

industry.description: Free text; used to infer entity_type when that is not given.

entity_type.description: All entity types are in scope. conglomerate = non-financial group that owns a bank/insurance/card arm (operating metrics plus financial-services metrics). bank/insurer/broker_dealer/other_financial use the financial-institution metric set (cost-to-income, NIM, cost of risk, loan-to-deposit, equity/assets, reported capital ratios, combined ratio).

accounting_framework.description: e.g. IFRS, HKFRS, US GAAP, CAS. CAS (China Accounting Standards) sets ebit_method to pretax_plus_interest automatically.

ebit_method.description: How EBIT is derived when no 'ebit' line is supplied. Use pretax_plus_interest whenever the reported operating profit is AFTER finance costs (CAS 营业利润).

periods.description: One entry per column. Average-based ratios need an opening balance, so the first column shows N/A for them.

period_type.description: interim for quarterly / half-year / year-to-date reports.

days.description: Days covered by the income and cash flow statements. Required for interim periods (e.g. Jan–Sep = 273/274) and for annual periods that are not 12 months (e.g. an 18-month period = 547/548); such periods are annualised.

flow_end.description: YYYY-MM-DD end date of the income/cash flow period.

balance_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date of the balance sheet column. In interim reports the comparative balance sheet is usually the prior year end, not the prior interim date.

audited.description: false when the report states the statements are unaudited (e.g. 未经审计); shown as UNAUDITED in the outputs.

cash_flow.description: Optional: omit when the entity presents no cash flow statement (e.g. FRS 101 / IAS 7 exemption).

supplementary.description: Non-statement inputs, e.g. shares_outstanding (same scale as unit) and share_price (in currency ones). Enables per-share and valuation ratios.

going_concern_uncertainty.description: true when the auditor reports a material uncertainty related to going concern.

key_disclosures.description: Up to five sourced disclosures shown on the Summary (restatements, regulatory breaches, cessation of trading, etc.).

no_cash_flow_reason.description: Why there is no cash flow statement, e.g. "exempt under FRS 101 (IAS 7)".

draft_review.description: Written by draft-map: items to check before analyze. Ignored by analyze.

ebit_includes_associates.description: Optional override: whether the EBIT used (reported ebit line or derived) already contains the post-tax share of associates/JVs. Normally detected automatically.

owners_profit_excludes_perpetual.description: true when net_income_attributable already excludes the perpetual holders' share (the income statement shows it as its own attribution line). Ordinary-shareholder ROE and EPS then use it directly without a perpetual_distributions line.

label.description: Original line label in the source

id.description: Unique across all statements. Use the canonical ids in metric-definitions.md so ratios can find the line; any other id is shown but not used by ratios.

section.description: Groups lines under a header (e.g. current_assets, operating, financing). Omit for grand totals.

total_of.description: Declares a subtotal: the workbook writes a live SUM of these line ids. If a reported value is also given, a tie-out check compares them. If any component is missing for a year, the reported value is used and the check is marked not tested.

tags.description: "debt": every interest-bearing borrowing line (short- and long-term borrowings, bonds, current portion of long-term debt, lease liabilities if treated as debt). "debt_like": financing-like items not in reported debt (e.g. notes payable / bank acceptance bills 应付票据); shown as a separate net-debt sensitivity. "perpetual": perpetual securities classified as debt. "impairment" / "non_recurring": one-off income-statement items. "attribution": non-owner shares of profit. "fs_operating": financial-services balance-sheet flows inside operating cash flow (conglomerates). "fx_translation": French écarts de conversion.

values.description: Keyed by year as a string. null = not disclosed. Use 0 only when the statement itself shows a blank or dash for that line in a column whose subtotal is printed (the source shows nil).

source.description: Single source applying to every year

sources.description: Per-year source keyed by year string; overrides 'source'.
